transcript: Speaker A: Nap time is the only free time that I get and I cannot waste it fighting the keyboard on my phone. I just walk around and talk. My content calendar, my emails, my follow-ups, and Wispr Flow writes it all out clean. No editing, no typing. Download Wispr Flow free today.
on_screen_text: When you have 22 minutes and a full brain. Download Wispr Flow free today.
summary: A mother demonstrates how she uses Wispr Flow to dictate emails and content hands-free during her limited free time. The ad highlights the app's clean transcription and ends with a free download CTA.
